mapper.select: select question_submit.question_id, question.title as question_title from question_submit left join question on question_submit.question_id = question.id where question_submit.user_id = #{userId} and question_submit.judge_status = 2 and question_submit.question_result = 1 and question_submit.is_deleted = 0 and question.is_deleted = 0 order by question.id asc
